newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse edges to new record close.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse edges to new record close.

text.p: French shares edged up to a fresh closing record on Thursday, helped by a positive reaction in the U.S. financial markets to inflation and other economic data.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 1.38 points, or 0.05 percent, at 2,776.01, surpassing Wednesday's closing record of 2,774.63 after erasing its early losses.
The CAC-40 May futures rose four points to 2,768.

* The oil sector led the advance. Total finished up 3.14 percent at 559 francs, extending its 4.43 percent gain on Wednesday, after analysts raised their estimates of the reserves of an Angolan oilfield in which Total owns 20 percent. A Total spokesman confirmed that Chevron, the operator of the block 14 field and owner of 31 percent, said the reserves were huge.
Elf shares, which rose 2.04 percent on Wednesday, closed up 1.33 percent at 608 francs, helped by higher Brent prices.
